title: Driving away stray thoughts (daf'-e-khatrat)
summary: What a khatra is, why a passing thought is forgiven but a resolve is not, and the outline of the methods the book gives for driving stray thoughts away.

blocks.p: Hazrat says the last paragraph on khatrat holds 'the gist of what we have been reading and listening to for a month'.

blocks.h: A passing thought and a resolve

blocks.q: A khatra is what comes and goes. When you make a firm intention about something, it is no longer a khatra; it becomes 'azm, a resolve. A khatra is forgiven; but the resolve is not forgiven.

blocks.p: If a good thought comes and we resolve on it, we are given its guidance. If a bad thought comes and we resolve on it, we become sinners, even if something stops us from doing it, though the burden is less than for the deed itself. Thoughts that come and go from morning to evening are not held to account.

The important principle, Hazrat reads, is nazar bar qadam: keep your gaze on your steps, lowered, not looking here and there. And khalwat dar anjuman, solitude in the crowd: keep your attention in your heart. Whatever face you keep looking at comes into the heart through the eyes, and a heart that looks all around becomes scattered.

blocks.q: For a few days, guard your gaze. When the heart is fixed on one point, the reality will come before you.

blocks.p: He adds a line of verse from the book: 'Many-coloured food brings impurity into the thoughts', and asks: if you think about everything instead of one direction, when will you reach your goal? Where will you find Tawheed?

blocks.q: O Master, we are waiting for Your grace. Take away these useless thoughts, and give us good thoughts.

steps: Change your state: if sitting, stand up; if standing, walk. The principle is movement.
Run from the thought, or picture it running away from you.
Come into Allah's refuge and ask Him to take the thoughts away.
A breathing method with the words 'hoon, hoon', which Hazrat demonstrates.
Reciting a verse of the Qur'an that the book names.

blocks.p: Even the awliya of Allah are troubled by khatrat, Hazrat says; they too come into Allah's refuge and use these methods. Elsewhere he teaches to call out A'udhu billahi min ash-shaytan ir-rajeem, 'not just the words: say it with hatred for him and a longing to be saved'.

blocks.note: The book's fifth method belongs, Hazrat says, to 'a very great station' and is not described here. Parts 6 to 9 are not yet public on YouTube, so those passages have no video link yet.
Learn this practice from your teacher before doing it.

ru.title: Bhatakte khayalaat ko door karna (daf'-e-khatrat)
ru.summary: Khatra kya hai, guzarta hua khayal kyun maaf hai lekin pakka iraada nahin, aur bhatakte khayalaat door karne ke jo tareeqe kitaab mein diye gaye hain unka khaaka.

blocks.p: Hazrat farmate hain ke khatrat par aakhri paragraph mein 'woh nichod hai jo hum ek mahine se padh rahe aur sun rahe hain'.

blocks.q: Khatra woh hai jo aata hai aur chala jaata hai. Jab aap kisi cheez ki pakki niyyat kar lete hain to woh khatra nahin rehta; woh 'azm ban jaata hai, yaani iraada. Khatra maaf hai; lekin 'azm maaf nahin.

blocks.p: Agar achha khayal aaye aur hum uska iraada kar lein to humein uski taufeeq di jaati hai. Agar bura khayal aaye aur hum uska iraada kar lein to hum gunahgaar ho jaate hain, chaahe koi cheez humein karne se rok de, agarche uska bojh asal amal se kam hai. Subah se shaam tak jo khayalaat aate jaate hain unka hisaab nahin hota.

Ahem usool, Hazrat padhte hain, nazar bar qadam hai: nazar apne qadmon par rakho, neechi, idhar udhar mat dekho. Aur khalwat dar anjuman, yaani bheed mein tanhaai: apni tawajjoh apne dil mein rakho. Jis chehre ko aap dekhte rehte hain woh aankhon ke raaste dil mein aa jaata hai, aur jo dil har taraf dekhta hai woh bikhar jaata hai.

blocks.q: Chand roz apni nazar ki hifaazat karo. Jab dil ek nukte par qaayam ho jaayega, haqeeqat saamne aa jaayegi.

blocks.p: Woh kitaab se ek sher ki line bhi sunaate hain: 'Rang-birang ki ghiza khayalaat mein napaaki laati hai', aur poochte hain: agar ek taraf ke bajaaye har cheez ke baare mein socho to manzil tak kab pahunchoge? Tauheed kahaan milegi?

blocks.q: Ae Maalik, hum Tere fazl ke muntazir hain. Yeh bekaar khayalaat hum se door kar de, aur humein achhe khayalaat ata farma.

steps: Apni haalat badlo: baithe ho to khade ho jao; khade ho to chalo. Usool harkat hai.
Khayal se bhaago, ya tasawwur karo ke woh tum se bhaag raha hai.
Allah ki panaah mein aao aur Us se dua karo ke khayalaat door kar de.
'Hoon, hoon' ke alfaaz ke saath saans ka ek tareeqa, jo Hazrat karke dikhaate hain.
Qur'an ki ek aayat ki tilaawat, jiska naam kitaab mein diya gaya hai.

blocks.p: Allah ke auliya bhi khatrat se pareshaan hote hain, Hazrat farmate hain; woh bhi Allah ki panaah mein aate hain aur yeh tareeqe istemaal karte hain. Ek aur jagah woh sikhaate hain ke A'udhu billahi min ash-shaytan ir-rajeem pukaaro, 'sirf alfaaz nahin: Shaitaan se nafrat aur bachne ki tadap ke saath kaho'.

blocks.note: Kitaab ka paanchwaan tareeqa, Hazrat farmate hain, 'bahut bade maqaam' ka hai aur yahaan bayaan nahin kiya gaya. Part 6 se 9 abhi YouTube par public nahin hain, isliye in hisson ka video link abhi nahin hai.
Yeh amal karne se pehle apne ustaad/shaykh se seekhiye.
